appName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the stores

appDescription.message: Translate the current page in-place with cloud LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok) using your own API key.

headerTagline.message: Replace any page with cloud LLMs

warnNoKey.message: No API key set for this provider.

modelRefreshTitle.message: Fetch the latest models (API key required)

statusPartial.message: Partly untranslated (rate limit / overload). Wait a bit and retry.

statusQuotaDaily.message: API quota reached (free daily limit or out of credit). Wait, upgrade, or switch provider (e.g. Groq).

statusSameLang.message: Page is already in the target language

statusNoKey.message: API key is not set for this service

statusBadKey.message: API key is invalid or unauthorized

optionsLead.message: Enter your own API key for each provider. Keys are stored locally in this browser and are sent only to that provider's API when translating.

optMyMemoryNote.message: No key needed. Add an email to raise the free daily limit (anonymous 5k / with email 50k chars/day). NMT engine, max 500 bytes per text.

optShowFabDesc.message: Show the floating translate button at the bottom-right of pages. When off, you can still translate from this popup or the context menu.

optShowImageBtnDesc.message: Show the "Translate" button when hovering over images.

optSelectionTranslateDesc.message: Select text and press Ctrl+Shift+L (or right-click) to translate. Choose how it appears below.

imgErrNoVision.message: This service does not support image translation (choose a supported service and set its key in API settings)

imgErrNoKey.message: API key is not set (enter it in API settings)

imgErrForbidden.message: This image could not be fetched

imgErrTooLarge.message: Image is too large to translate

imgErrNotImage.message: Could not read this as an image

qtPlaceholder.message: Type or paste here (does not translate the page)

qtSpeakInTitle.message: Speak the source text (click again to stop)

qtSpeakOutTitle.message: Speak the translation (click again to stop)

qtNoKey.message: No API key set for this provider

qtLimit.message: Too long for this provider — shorten it or pick an LLM provider
